tldr: 美國國際貿易法院裁定川普政府全球 10% 關稅違法，重新點燃出口導向經濟體的政策不確定性。
台灣 4 月 CPI 年增 1.74%、寫一年新高，能源與食物推升通膨，5 月升幅恐再擴大。
加權指數 5/7 收 41,933 點、單日大漲 1.93%，外資 4 月匯入逾 8,000 億創史上單月新高；費半昨日大跌 2.72%，台股短線恐進入震盪整理。
美伊荷姆茲海峽交火，油價跳漲 4%、美股期指走軟，川普稱停火仍有效但市場仍存疑。
AI 與 HBM 供不應求逼出科技巨頭出資協助 SK 海力士擴產；OpenAI 自研晶片融資受阻，博通盤中重挫逾 3%。

items.title_zh: 加權指數 5/7 收 41,933 點 單月大漲、外資 4 月狂匯逾 8,000 億創史上新高
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 1.93% to record 41,933 as April foreign net buying tops NT$8 trillion
items.summary_zh: 加權指數 5 月 7 日收 41,933.78 點，大漲 794.93 點、漲幅 1.93%。背後是 4 月外資匯入逾 8,000 億元（約 2,640 億美元），創下史上單月最大金額；歷史前六大單月外資匯入中，2026 年已包辦三個月，反映 AI 伺服器、半導體與 HBM 需求對台股的高度依賴。
items.summary_en: TAIEX closed May 7 up 794.93 points (+1.93%) at 41,933.78, fueled by April foreign net inflows of more than NT$8 trillion (≈US$264bn) — the largest monthly figure on record. Three of the six largest single-month foreign inflows in history have now occurred in 2026, driven by AI server, semiconductor and HBM demand.

items.title_zh: 費半挫 2.72% 投顧：台股漲多後將整理
items.title_en: SOX -2.72% overnight, brokers warn Taiwan stocks face near-term consolidation
items.summary_zh: 費城半導體指數下跌 2.72%，美中東情勢與 OpenAI 自研晶片融資受阻拖累晶片股。本土投顧認為台股累計漲幅已大，預期短線進入箱型整理，資金將輪動至落後補漲股與高殖利率金融族群。
items.summary_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 2.72% as US chip names retreated on Iran tensions and OpenAI chip-financing concerns. Local brokerages say after a sharp run-up, TAIEX is likely to enter a sideways consolidation phase, with positioning shifting toward laggards and high-yield financials.

items.title_zh: 法人喊台股 50K 非夢事
items.title_en: Brokers say TAIEX 50,000 "not a dream" amid AI capex cycle
items.summary_zh: 主要本土外資機構重申，受惠多年期 AI 資本支出週期、企業獲利動能與外資持續加碼，加權指數結構性挑戰 50,000 點具有支撐；惟示警晶片權值股部位過度集中為短線最大風險。
items.summary_en: Major sell-side desks reiterate that the index has structural support to challenge 50,000 on the back of the multi-year AI capex cycle, record corporate earnings momentum, and continued foreign positioning, while flagging crowded longs in heavyweight chip names as the main near-term risk.

items.title_zh: 台股大型公司 4 月營收速報出爐
items.title_en: Taiwan large caps release April monthly revenues
items.summary_zh: 鉅亨網彙整大型權值公司 4 月自結營收，AI 半導體、伺服器代工、HBM 相關材料供應商持續年增；傳產則受到關稅與匯率干擾，表現分歧。
items.summary_en: Anue's flash report on Taiwan's largest listed companies' April monthly sales shows continued YoY revenue strength in AI-exposed semiconductors, server ODMs and HBM-related materials suppliers, while traditional sectors remain mixed amid tariff and FX headwinds.

items.title_zh: 鴻海赴波蘭設電動車組裝廠
items.title_en: Foxconn to set up EV assembly plant in Poland
items.summary_zh: 鴻海集團將 CDMS 模式帶進歐洲，規劃波蘭電動車組裝產能，鞏固對歐系車廠的 Tier-1 供應鏈地位，同時為可能的美國關稅政策提供避險布局。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai is expanding its CDMS (Contract Design & Manufacturing Service) playbook into Europe, planning EV assembly capacity in Poland. The move tightens Foxconn's footprint as a Tier-1 supplier to European OEMs and creates a hedge against potential US tariff regimes.

items.title_zh: 聯發科 AI 超算中心亮相 3 台廠扮要角 股王信驊機器人推一把
items.title_en: MediaTek unveils AI super-compute center, Aspeed and 3 Taiwan partners join robotics push
items.summary_zh: 聯發科發表 AI 超算中心，攜手三家台灣供應鏈廠商；股王信驊（5274）以伺服器 BMC 與邊緣機器人平台切入此一建置，使台股 AI 生態圈擴大至晶圓代工與封測之外。
items.summary_en: MediaTek launched its AI super-compute center with three Taiwan supply-chain partners; chip "king" Aspeed (5274) is positioning its server BMC and edge robotics platform for the build-out, broadening the AI ecosystem beyond TSMC and packaging plays.

items.title_zh: AI 需求爆發、HBM 供不應求 科技巨頭搶替 SK 海力士出資擴產
items.title_en: HBM supply gap pushes hyperscalers to co-fund SK Hynix expansion
items.summary_zh: AI 加速器需求遠超過 HBM 供給，外媒指雲端業者正協商共同出資擴大 SK 海力士產能、鎖定供貨；台廠 HBM 測試、ABF、基板鏈（信驊、欣興、聯茂等）續受惠。
items.summary_en: With AI accelerator demand outpacing HBM supply, foreign media report that global hyperscalers are negotiating to co-fund SK Hynix capacity expansion to lock in allocation. The shortage benefits Taiwan's HBM testing, ABF, and substrate suppliers (e.g. Aspeed, Unimicron, ITEQ).

items.title_zh: OpenAI 晶片計畫融資受阻 博通盤中急挫逾 3%
items.title_en: OpenAI's chip financing stalls; Broadcom slumps over 3%
items.summary_zh: 外媒指 OpenAI 自研 AI 加速器融資方案進展不順，博通盤中重挫逾 3%，拖累美晶片股全線走弱，亦是費半昨日大跌 2.72% 的主因之一。
items.summary_en: Reports that OpenAI's bespoke AI-accelerator financing package is hitting roadblocks dragged Broadcom down more than 3% intraday, weighing on the broader US chip complex and feeding into the SOX's overnight 2.72% drop.

items.title_zh: 蘋果「相機版」AirPods 進入測試階段
items.title_en: Apple's "camera-equipped" AirPods enters internal testing
items.summary_zh: 蘋果傳測試內建相機的新一代 AirPods，藉由視覺資訊餵養端側與雲端 AI 助理。若量產，將為台灣光學與聲學零組件供應鏈（大立光、玉晶光、富士康等）帶來新題材。
items.summary_en: Apple is reportedly testing an AirPods variant with embedded cameras, designed to feed visual context to on-device and cloud AI assistants. If launched, this becomes another Taiwan ODM/optical-component opportunity (LARGAN, Genius, AAC, Foxlink etc.).

items.title_zh: 市況走堅 台塑四寶 Q2 營運看升
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics big four Q2 outlook upgraded as conditions firm
items.summary_zh: 台塑集團四寶（台塑、南亞、台化、台塑化）指出，第二季營運可望回升：石化價差止穩、中國需求改善、新台幣偏弱共同支撐；分析師小幅上修全年 EPS 預估。
items.summary_en: Formosa Plastics Group's "big four" (FPC, NPC, FCFC, FPCC) point to a Q2 operational rebound on stabilizing petchem spreads, improving China demand and a softer NTD; brokers raise full-year EPS forecasts modestly.

items.title_zh: 正新董座羅才仁將回歸掌舵
items.title_en: Cheng Shin Rubber chairman Lo Tsai-jen returns to lead
items.summary_zh: 正新輪胎（瑪吉斯母公司）宣布創辦家族羅才仁回任董事長，帶領集團因應關稅變局與電動車胎轉型；市場視為傳產龍頭領導層穩定訊號。
items.summary_en: Maxxis-parent Cheng Shin Rubber announced founder-family Lo Tsai-jen will return as chairman to steer the group through tariff disruptions and EV-tire transition; market sees this as a stabilizing leadership signal for traditional sector heavyweights.

items.title_zh: 聯發科關禁閉 將設排除條款
items.title_en: MediaTek installs export-control "exclusion clauses" for restricted customers
items.summary_zh: 因應美國出口管制收緊，聯發科將在客戶合約加入排除條款，確保合規並限制下游再出口風險，顯示台灣晶片業的法遵架構正在深度改寫。
items.summary_en: Following tightening US export controls, MediaTek is amending customer terms with explicit exclusion clauses to ensure compliance and limit downstream re-export risks; shows the depth of compliance reconfiguration in Taiwan's chip industry.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布 3 月信用卡、電子支付業務及本國銀行逾放統計
items.title_en: FSC publishes March 2026 credit/e-payment data and bank NPL update
items.summary_zh: 金管會銀行局發布 115 年 3 月信用卡、現金卡及電子支付機構業務資訊，以及 3 月底本國銀行逾期放款情形：電子支付交易續呈兩位數年增，國銀逾放比仍處結構性低點。
items.summary_en: The FSC Banking Bureau released March 2026 monthly figures for credit cards, cash cards and electronic-payment institutions, alongside the end-March overdue-loan ratio for domestic banks. Data show electronic-payment volume continues double-digit YoY growth while bank NPLs remain at structurally low levels.

items.title_zh: 搶攻高資產！渣打首推保單融資 並與凱雷合作私募股權基金
items.title_en: Standard Chartered Taiwan launches HNW policy-loan program, partners Carlyle for PE fund
items.summary_zh: 渣打銀行成為國內首家提供完整保單融資方案的外銀，鎖定高資產客戶；同時與凱雷合作推出私募股權基金，顯示外銀財管平台與本土金控的競爭升級。
items.summary_en: Standard Chartered becomes the first foreign bank in Taiwan to offer a full insurance-policy financing line targeting HNW clients, and announces a co-launched private-equity fund with Carlyle, signaling intensifying competition in foreign-bank wealth platforms versus local financial holdings.

items.title_zh: 中信《2026 臺灣超高資產客群財富洞察報告》：高資產 12.4 萬人、掌握 46 兆元
items.title_en: CTBC Holding's 2026 Taiwan UHNW report: 124k clients, NT$46tn AUM target
items.summary_zh: 中信金控發布的 2026 高資產報告指出，台灣 1 億元以上高資產族群將達 12.4 萬人、掌握財富 46.1 兆元；2029 年個人財富規模可望以年均約 10% 成長至 59 兆元，跨境配置、家族辦公室、家族信託成為三大核心題材。
items.summary_en: CTBC Holding's "2026 Taiwan UHNW Wealth Insights" projects HNW (NT$100m+) population growing to 124,000 by 2026, controlling NT$46.1tn; HNW personal wealth seen at ≈10% CAGR to NT$59tn by 2029, with cross-border allocation, family offices and family trusts as the core themes.

items.title_zh: 渣打保單融資 + 凱雷私募股權基金 重塑私銀戰場
items.title_en: Standard Chartered's HNW policy-loan and Carlyle PE fund redefine private-banking competition
items.summary_zh: 渣打首推完整保單融資方案、並與凱雷合作私募股權基金，鎖定高資產客戶釋放保單現金價值、並取得全球 PE alpha，將迫使本土金控升級財管商品線與 AUM 收費結構。
items.summary_en: Standard Chartered's first-of-its-kind insurance-policy financing line and Carlyle-partnered PE fund target Taiwan's HNW segment, allowing clients to monetize policy cash value and access global PE alpha — pressuring local financial holdings to upgrade product shelves and AUM-fee structures.

items.title_zh: 高資產族群 12.4 萬人、財富 46 兆 家族辦公室成治理中樞
items.title_en: HNW segment to reach 124,000 with NT$46tn assets — family office becomes governance hub
items.summary_zh: 中信 2026 報告指出，高資產人口與規模快速放大，財管業者正從商品銷售升級為家族辦公室治理、跨世代信託架構與跨境稅務／法務整合。
items.summary_en: Per CTBC's 2026 report, HNW client count and AUM are scaling fast, prompting wealth managers to evolve from product distribution toward family-office governance, multi-generational trust structures and cross-border tax/legal coordination.

items.title_zh: 台灣企業家透過「家族辦公室」與「AI 投資」重塑財富版圖
items.title_en: Family-office and AI-powered investing reshape Taiwan's UHNW wealth playbook
items.summary_zh: 產業報告指出，台灣企業家結合家族辦公室與 AI 驅動投組，因應跨境不動產、結構型商品、私募債、二級市場等資產複雜度上升，為信託與投信投顧帶來新業務機會。
items.summary_en: Industry reports highlight how Taiwan entrepreneurs are combining family-office structures with AI-driven portfolio construction to manage rising portfolio complexity (cross-border real estate, structured notes, private credit, secondaries), creating new mandates for Taiwan trust companies and SITCs.

items.title_zh: 長照特別扣除額調升至 18 萬元 自 114 年度起適用
items.title_en: MOF: long-term-care special deduction raised to NT$180,000 from FY2025
items.summary_zh: 財政部臺北國稅局表示，自 114 年 1 月 1 日起，符合衛福部公告條件的身心失能者，每人每年長照特別扣除額由原額度提高至 18 萬元，減輕中低所得照顧家庭負擔。
items.summary_en: MOF's Taipei NTB confirms the long-term-care special deduction is raised to NT$180,000 per qualifying disabled dependent per year from January 1, 2025, easing the burden on middle- and lower-income caregivers; eligibility requires conditions specified by MOHW.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／夫妻分居 四情境分開報稅
items.title_en: NTB clarifies four scenarios where separated couples may file taxes separately
items.summary_zh: 國稅局提醒綜合所得稅原則上採家戶課稅、夫妻須合併申報；分居或符合特定法定條件方得分開申報，並列出 4 種常見情境，避免納稅人誤踩地雷。
items.summary_en: National Taxation Bureau warns that Taiwan's individual income tax remains household-based; legally separated couples must still meet specific statutory conditions before filing separately. Four common scenarios are outlined for the 2026 filing season.

items.title_zh: 普發萬元 2,336 萬人領取 4 月新生兒 5 月 22 日前領取
items.title_en: Universal NT$10,000 cash payout reaches 23.36 million people; April newborns deadline May 22
items.summary_zh: 國庫署表示，普發萬元現金已超過 2,336 萬人領取；一般民眾期限已於 4 月 30 日截止，4 月份出生新生兒父母須在 5 月 22 日前完成領取。
items.summary_en: National Treasury says the universal NT$10,000 payout has reached 23.36 million people. The general claim window closed April 30; April-born newborns' parents must complete claims by May 22.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／網路報綜所稅 列首批退稅
items.title_en: Online income-tax filers prioritized for first refund batch
items.summary_zh: 財政部表示，採用網路申報綜合所得稅的納稅人將列為首批退稅對象，較紙本申報者更快收到退稅款。
items.summary_en: MOF confirms that taxpayers e-filing the 2026 annual income-tax return will be placed on the first refund batch, accelerating refund timing for online filers vs paper filers.

items.title_zh: 企業高價車提列折舊 留意限額
items.title_en: Corporate luxury-vehicle depreciation: watch the cap
items.summary_zh: 國稅局提醒，企業提列高價自用乘人車輛折舊有法定限額，超額部分將於營所稅審核時遭剔除補稅。
items.summary_en: NTB reminds enterprises that depreciation of high-value passenger vehicles is subject to a statutory cap; over-allocations beyond the cap will be disallowed and reassessed during income-tax review.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法草案：死亡前 2 年內贈與配偶／繼承人按比例分擔
items.title_en: Estate-and-gift-tax bill: 2-year prior gifts to spouse/heirs to be allocated pro-rata
items.summary_zh: 財政部 2026 年 1 月 22 日預告修正遺產及贈與稅法部分條文草案：被繼承人死亡前 2 年內贈與配偶、各順序繼承人之財產併入遺產時，遺產稅由各受贈人按受贈財產占遺產比例負擔，將直接影響家族信託與世代贈與安排。
items.summary_en: MOF's draft amendment (announced Jan 22, 2026) requires that gifts within two years before death made to the spouse or any statutory heirs, when added back to the estate, have the resulting estate-tax liability allocated to each donee in proportion to their share — directly affecting family-trust and inter-generational gifting strategy.

items.title_zh: 4 月 CPI 年增 1.74%、寫一年新高 5 月通膨升幅恐再擴大
items.title_en: April CPI rises 1.74% YoY — one-year high; May reading expected hotter
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布 4 月 CPI 年增 1.74%、為一年新高，能源年增 13.6%（4 年新高）、食物物價僵固性偏高；主計總處示警 5 月通膨升幅可能再擴大，將為央行的寬鬆傾向帶來牽制。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April CPI accelerated to +1.74% YoY (a one-year high) on +13.6% energy costs (highest in four years) tied to Middle East tensions, while food prices remained sticky. DGBAS sees May CPI rising further, complicating the central bank's dovish bias.

items.title_zh: 台廠投資美國擬加碼兆元 經濟部首期融資方案啟動
items.title_en: MOEA preps NT$1tn+ first-phase financing to support Taiwan firms' US investments
items.summary_zh: 經濟部指 20 家台廠赴美投資金額達 350 億美元（約 1.05 兆元新台幣），將推動首期融資方案（市場傳達 500 億美元規模），協助廠商在美設廠、設研發與供應鏈中心，搶在關稅進一步擴大前完成布局。
items.summary_en: MOEA confirms 20 Taiwan corporations have committed US$35bn (≈NT$1.05tn) of US investment, and is launching a first-phase financing facility (reported up to US$50bn package) to help firms land plants, R&D and supply-chain hubs in the US ahead of further tariff actions.

items.title_zh: 美國貿易法庭裁定川普全球 10% 關稅違法 川普遭打臉再＋1
items.title_en: US Court of International Trade rules Trump's blanket 10% tariff unlawful
items.summary_zh: 美國國際貿易法庭裁定，川普政府全球 10% 進口關稅措施已逾越法定授權；若維持原判，將實質改寫台灣出口廠商（汽車零組件、機械、電子、石化等）的定價與供應鏈假設。
items.summary_en: The US Court of International Trade ruled that the Trump administration's blanket 10% tariff exceeds statutory authority. The ruling, if upheld, materially reshapes pricing and supply-chain assumptions for Taiwan exporters in autos, machinery, electronics and petchem.

items.title_zh: 花蓮地震規模 4.4　最大震度花蓮縣 3 級
items.title_en: Magnitude-4.4 earthquake jolts Hualien; max intensity 3
items.summary_zh: 花蓮上午發生規模 4.4 地震，最大震度 3 級；目前晶圓廠、港口、運輸節點未傳出立即損害。
items.summary_en: A magnitude-4.4 earthquake hit Hualien in the morning with maximum intensity 3 on the Taiwan scale; no immediate damage reported to fabs, ports or transport hubs.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤／三大指數收低 晶片股回落 美伊局勢拖累
items.title_en: US three majors close lower as chip stocks slide on Mideast tension
items.summary_zh: 美股三大指數收黑，晶片股領跌：美伊衝突、荷姆茲海峽風險與 OpenAI 自研晶片融資受阻共同打壓。避險情緒延伸至亞洲晶片股。
items.summary_en: All three US benchmarks closed in the red overnight; semiconductor names led losses on Iran tensions, Hormuz risk, and OpenAI's chip-financing trouble. Risk-off positioning extended into Taiwan and Asia chip names overnight.

items.title_zh: 美伊在荷姆茲海峽交火 油價跳漲 4%、美股期指走軟
items.title_en: US-Iran clash at Strait of Hormuz lifts oil 4%, presses futures
items.summary_zh: 美伊在荷姆茲海峽附近交火，原油價格跳漲 4%、美股期指承壓。全球海運石油約有 20% 經過此海峽，任何中斷風險都將被放大。
items.summary_en: A US-Iran exchange of fire near the Strait of Hormuz pushed crude oil up 4% and weighed on US equity futures. Roughly 20% of seaborne global oil flows through the strait, magnifying any disruption risk.

items.title_zh: 川普：美伊停火依然有效 荷姆茲局勢已平靜
items.title_en: Trump: US-Iran ceasefire still holds, Hormuz situation has calmed
items.summary_zh: 川普對媒體表示美伊停火仍有效、荷姆茲局勢已平靜，試圖降溫避險情緒，惟油價仍處警戒狀態。
items.summary_en: Trump told reporters that the US-Iran ceasefire remains in effect and the Hormuz situation has "calmed down" — an attempt to defuse risk-off positioning, though oil markets remain on alert.

items.title_zh: 馬斯克為 SpaceX 找到下一台印鈔機：AI 算力房東
items.title_en: Musk hunts SpaceX's next cash cow: AI compute landlord
items.summary_zh: 馬斯克據傳將 SpaceX 衛星星座與地面站閒置電力／算力包裝成 AI 算力即服務（AI Compute-as-a-Service），扮演「AI 算力房東」角色，與超大型雲端業者的 AI 基礎建設競爭。
items.summary_en: Musk is reportedly positioning SpaceX to monetize idle satellite-constellation power and ground-station capacity into AI-compute-as-a-service, becoming an "AI compute landlord" — a structural new revenue line that competes with hyperscalers' AI infrastructure plays.

items.title_zh: 不為 1,100 萬心動！三星工會拒絕一次性補償
items.title_en: Samsung union rejects KRW-record one-time compensation, holds out for structural reform
items.summary_zh: 三星工會拒絕創新高的 1,100 萬元等值一次性補償方案，堅持結構性薪酬改革。此為韓國科技業勞動成本升溫指標，亦將牽動記憶體與 HBM 成本曲線。
items.summary_en: Samsung's union turned down a record one-off compensation offer of NT$11mn equivalent per employee, demanding structural pay reform instead — signaling escalating labour-cost pressure across Korean tech and a swing factor for memory/HBM cost curves.
